label_status: owner-approved 2026-10-15; labelled from the pack, before any run of this ticker
rationale: Undisputed quality (operating margin about 29%, ten steady years) at a premium price (P/E about 29, EV/EBIT about 30) for low single-digit growth: 'great company, priced for perfection'. STRONG_CASE would need the price to support interest too.

rationale: Flat revenue (3-year CAGR about 0.6%) but operating margins of 12-21% over ten years (17-19% in the last three) and about 20 billion of free cash flow over the last twelve months, at a price of about 6.7 times earnings and 3.7 times free cash flow (yield about 27%), with about 84 billion of debt. The valuation is low: for example a P/E around 7, or a free cash flow yield around 20% or more.
must_not: Describes the stock as expensive or says the price requires strong growth.
